_readme: Review queue for towns/counties recurring in archived-but-unlocalized story tracker headlines (data/story_candidates.json). Generated by scripts/scan_locality_candidates.py, capped at --max-new (default 39) newly-surfaced names per run. Nothing here is published or cited anywhere on the site. To promote a candidate: research its governing body (its own .gov/town page, never a search snippet) and, if it has taken a real vote, its outcome from the vote's own coverage; add a LOCAL_BODIES_DF row (ongoing fight) and/or a MORATORIUMS_DF row (a confirmed enacted/rejected/proposed vote) in src/constants.py, then run `scripts/backfill_story_candidates.py --relabel` so already-archived stories for that place regroup correctly. Set this entry's status to 'promoted' once done, or 'dismissed' if it's not a real distinct place (a stopword slipped through, or it's already covered under a different name) — dismissed entries are never re-queued.
